expected.finding: **[P2]** Timeout cleanup can hang indefinitely in [http-body.ts:69](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/packages/shared/src/http-body.ts:69). The finalizer awaits `reader.cancel()` before releasing the lock. If the underlying stream’s cancellation promise never settles, cleanup never completes. Because `acquireUseRelease` waits for its uninterruptible finalizer, both `Effect.timeout` and `Fiber.interrupt` can remain pending indefinitely. Bound the cancellation wait and release the lock independently of cancellation settling. Add coverage for an asynchronous, stalled `cancel()`; the current tests only cover immediate cancellation.
